name: Placeholder text
author: Lienzo UI
description: Fills empty texts with lorem ipsum that fits each box, and removes it again when the real content arrives.

commands.name: Fill empty texts
commands.description: Gives lorem ipsum to empty Text elements (sized to the box), labels to empty buttons and toggles, hints to input fields and options to empty dropdowns.

commands.name: Remove lorem ipsum
commands.description: Clears every text that starts with Lorem.
